context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 野鳥/密室/完走/称さ/代々/比し/戦中/脅かさ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、野鳥観察、自由研究、よくできましたね。
lines.en: Sakura, your bird-watching project was really well done.
lines.style: Warm, specific praise. Open and steady. Genuine attention settling on her work, not performing encouragement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。密室から観察できる工夫、章にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I made a whole chapter about how to observe from a closed room.
lines.style: Direct, a little proud. Quick tempo. Not defensive—just stating what she did. Brief, because she's used to being heard.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨年の完走、自信、ついたでしょう。
lines.en: Finishing it last year must have given you real confidence for this one.
lines.style: Observant, gentle push forward. Steady breath. Not filling space—letting the connection land. A teacher who remembers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。研究者の祖父、地元で名人と称されています。
lines.en: Yes. My grandfather—he was a researcher. People around here call him a master of it.
lines.style: Careful, testing ground. Quiet pride underneath. Slight hesitation before naming it, like she's checking if it's okay to say.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 代々の研究記録、いい遺産ですね。
lines.en: Having generations of research records like that is a real legacy.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Slow. Recognizing something larger than the project. Sincere without being effusive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昔のフィールドノートに比し、デジタル化、進めました。
lines.en: I digitized a lot of his old field notes—compared to what he had before, it's much more organized now.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact explanation. Steady pace. She's focused on the work itself, not the feeling of it. A little technical.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦中の野鳥観察、貴重な記録ですね。
lines.en: The wartime bird observations in there are really precious records.
lines.style: Recognizing weight. Slower pace, slightly awed. She's understanding aloud what she's holding. The gravity landing as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 生態系が脅かされる時代、警鐘の章で書きました。
lines.en: I wrote a whole chapter about that—how ecosystems were being threatened even then. It felt like a warning that needed to be told.
lines.style: Conviction building through the sentence. Leaning into the purpose. Serious tempo. Finishing firm—this mattered to write.
